svg.title: A stride of 2 moves the kernel two cells at a time and shrinks the output
svg.desc: Left, the cover with the four windows of a stride-2 convolution outlined and the 2 by 2 output; right, the zero-padded cover with the first three windows outlined and the 3 by 3 output; grey cells are never read.

g.text: Windows start at columns 1 and 3, then
the next would run off the edge: the grey
last row and column are never read.
The first row of windows is outlined; the rows below
repeat it two cells lower. The grey bottom row and
right column of the padded cover are skipped, as in
Dumoulin and Visin's Figure 2.7 for the same sizes.
Colours pair each window with the output cell it produces.
